# pb — sqlc codegen plugin protocol types

Generated Go types for the sqlc process-plugin protocol (binary on stdin/stdout). The source proto is taken from the **sqlc module** (via `go list -m` / replace).

**Generated files**

- `codegen.pb.go` — generated by `make proto` from `protos/plugin/codegen.proto` in the resolved `github.com/sqlc-dev/sqlc` module.

**Regenerating**

From the repo root:

```bash
make proto
```

Requires `protoc`, `protoc-gen-go`, and `go mod download`:

```bash
go install google.golang.org/protobuf/cmd/protoc-gen-go@latest
```
